name: AI Red Teamer

exam.format: Proctored 24-hour practical exam against an AI-enabled enterprise network: two attack chains and a standalone AI-focused host, eight scored targets worth 100 points. Another 24 hours to upload the report.

scope: Advanced AI red teaming across LLMs, multi-agent systems, RAG, embeddings and infrastructure.
ai_policy: OffSec's OSAI exam guide sets no tool restrictions and strongly encourages using AI throughout the exam; asking other people for help is still forbidden.

discounts.text: Learn One (a year of one course, its labs and two exam attempts) was shown at $2,199 instead of $2,749 on 2026-11-17, as OffSec's 20th-anniversary offer; no end date was shown.

access.retake: Learn One includes two exam attempts; the Course + Cert Bundle includes one.
